{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for loyal customers
df_loyal = df[df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Compute the conversion rate
converted_count = df_loyal['converted'].sum()
total_loyal = len(df_loyal)
conversion_rate = converted_count / total_loyal

# Print the conversion rate as a float
print(conversion_rate)"}
